items.title: 视频后期，危！MiniMax H3手绘即特效，多模态的「Coding时刻」来了
items.summary_en: MiniMax released H3, the first open-source video model, featuring end-to-end generation that integrates editing, subtitles, transitions, VFX, and music into a single production-ready output at 2K resolution. Ranked #1 on the Artificial Analysis video editing benchmark, H3 supports full multimodal input (text, image, audio, video) and is priced at less than 1/3 of mainstream models at 2K and less than 1/2 at 768P, with weights open for private deployment.

items.title: Seedance 级别的全模态控制，MiniMax H3 的商业视频成片新解法
items.summary_en: MiniMax has released the open-source video model MiniMax H3, featuring Seedance-level full-modal precise control and AI-native post-production capabilities. The model supports mixed inputs of up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio clips, and excels at object/background replacement, style transfer, and generating complete commercial videos directly from text prompts for ads, e-commerce, and UI design. It topped Artificial Analysis's global video editing leaderboard upon launch, surpassing Gemini Omni, with strong performance in precise editing tasks like single-object swaps, multi-subject manipulation, and camera angle adjustments while preserving original motion and composition.

items.title: smevals - a small eval suite for evaluating models, prompts, and harnesses
items.summary_en: smevals is a lightweight eval framework developed at Jesse Vincent's Prime Radiant applied AI research lab for running evaluations across different model configurations and grading results. It uses a structured vocabulary where evals contain tasks, configs specify models or prompts, runners execute tasks, and graders produce grades via checks or custom checkers. Key commands include `uvx smevals run` for executing evaluations, `uvx smevals grade` for grading, `uvx smevals serve` for a local web server to explore results, and `uvx smevals build` for generating static HTML reports.

items.title: Show HN: Agents that learn and remember. On your machine, under your control
items.summary_en: **exxperts** is a local-first AI desktop app by **Exxeta AG** that runs governed, approval-gated memory agents on your machine. It supports any AI provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, local models) via OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and integrates **MCP tools** and built-in **DuckDuckGo** web search. Every memory links back to its source conversation, lives as plain local files with no telemetry, and users can review, edit, or reject what the agent learns after each session.

items.title: Show HN: An LSP for agent skills–rename, references, completion, and diagnostics
items.summary: 该工具为agent skills提供了完整的LSP支持，包括rename、references、completion和diagnostics功能，可一键安装至VS Code、Cursor、Windsurf、VSCodium、Zed等编辑器。支持go-to-definition、智能补全、悬停描述、broken links修复，以及针对YAML格式错误、重复键、无效类型和XML不平衡的精确诊断。
items.summary_en: A developer built an LSP (Language Server Protocol) for agent skills, adding features like go-to-definition, skill completions, refactoring with auto-renaming of folders and names, references, description-on-hover, and diagnostics for YAML/XML errors. It supports one-click installation for VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium, and Zed.

items.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
items.summary: Google 周四在卫星地图应用 Google Earth 中推出基于提示词的 AI 图像生成功能 Nano Banana 2，允许用户将虚构图像叠加在真实地图上。该功能上线仅一天后即因可能被滥用于制造和传播虚假信息遭广泛批评而被撤回，Google 正着手加强内容审核护栏。
items.summary_en: Google launched and then rapidly withdrew a Google Earth feature that let users superimpose AI-generated images via its Nano Banana 2 image generator onto satellite maps. The tool was scrapped just one day after release amid concerns it could be used to spread geospatial misinformation, with Google acknowledging it saw generated imagery violating its policies. The company says it is rolling back the feature while implementing stronger guardrails before potentially relaunching.

items.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content

items.summary_en: Snapchat will no longer reward fully AI-generated videos on its Spotlight feature, adjusting its recommendation system so only human-created content qualifies. Creators can still use Snapchat's AI tools to enhance or edit their videos, but the platform prioritizes authentic, original human creativity. The move aligns with a growing industry trend, as companies like YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn, and Substack also crack down on low-quality AI-generated content.

directions.name: SketchMotion 动效画师

directions.description_en: Turn hand-drawn sketches into animated effects videos using AI, a motion graphics tool for independent creators

directions.target_user_en: Short-video creators, indie animators, content marketers

多风格特效模板（漫画风、写实风、科幻风）
一键导出 1080p/4K 视频，支持透明通道
core_features_en: Hand-drawn sketch input with AI auto-recognition to generate dynamic effects
One-click export in 1080p/4K with transparent channel support

directions.why_now_en: MiniMax H3 open-source model enables hand-drawn to effect generation, with community buzz around multimodal 'Coding moment' (Quantumbit 8/10). Reddit has creators complaining about high barriers for motion tools, while HN discusses surging demand for open-source video generation tools. Independent developers can quickly build vertical tools using open-source models to meet the urgent need for low-cost motion effects among short-video creators.
